title: Broken copier
passage: Why is the copier switched off? A. Twenty copies, please. B. It kept jamming this morning. C. The switch is on the left.
passageZh:
為什麼影印機關閉了？
A. 請給我二十份。
B. 它今天早上一直卡紙。
C. 開關在左邊。
audioScript: Why is the copier switched off? A. Twenty copies, please. B. It kept jamming this morning. C. The switch is on the left.
